detail:
New decision "Superseded the process-start-time self-post heuristic with posted-id membership (BlackboardEngine.sessionPostIds -> ContextAssembler.setSessionPostIds)" relates to:
- 01KHMSF111C2M13V2EM2H91G5E: "Use ULIDs for all entity IDs — temporally sortable, globally unique"
- 01KHMSF83J0CN3599E4681ER6A: "Decisions track commit hashes to link architectural choices to git history"
- 01KHN3H7GHVWN89R1WVCHANX2V: "Direct fs calls in DecisionEngine for STATE.md sync — deliberate exception to storage-layer convention"
- 01KHW8KE6TG4B54G85CV67VHZK: "Implement drift detection via git log and sandboxed constraint checking via execSync"
- 01KHXTWYETCEF91HQD0HMA2SG4: "Switch execGit to execFileSync with argument arrays; replace broken shell operator blocklist with newline/null-byte validation"
- 01KHXTX64263644BDF1JDRFD30: "Fix race conditions by using single index lock for atomic file+index updates in DecisionStore and HandoffStore"
- 01KHXTXC89M8MN7KZ34MG75JWK: "Move archive file writes inside blackboard lock to prevent data loss on crash"
- 01KHXTXPM9EVV02HGF8X0V6ZYX: "Fix token budget accounting: warnings get priority access to full budget, non-warnings capped at 90%"
- 01KJC68KWE17FYM6D111ZD4PVM: "Add project name to dashboard title/header and GitHub icon link — fixes #2 and #3"
- 01KJD8KGC5ZCFNQD5KETTQ32YH: "Add twining_dismiss tool for targeted removal of blackboard entries by ID"
- 01KJJ340SQV8S2GN1S4FWXMKBP: "Redesign dashboard UI with dark-first professional theme using Sora/DM Sans/JetBrains Mono fonts and teal accent color"
- 01KJJ348G20Z2SYKBZ8WNXDQME: "Prevent duplicate browser tabs by checking health endpoint before auto-opening"
- 01KJJ34D0940TD59ET8M9TY5E2: "Show session-ended overlay after 3 consecutive poll failures instead of attempting window.close()"
- 01KJJCBK7NW40PQ9RE2625AJ9B: "Fix timeline zoom by changing overflow:auto to overflow:hidden and add zoom controls toolbar"
- 01KJJE3F7YJJBF74FJWVP4ESHK: "Replace search bar multi-select with toggle chips, add search icon, and style filters to match toolbar design language"
- 01KJJSJT5XEWWY7AXY29KBCS6N: "Add twining_register MCP tool and subagent coordination integration (dispatch skill, SubagentStop hook, aware-worker agent)"
- 01KJJZFSFB5CD2Q804A0HGJCMB: "Include projectRoot in health endpoint to distinguish same-project vs different-project dashboard instances"
- 01KM6CEQMN44C52G93V99JQ1H0: "Reorder formatForLLM: warnings first, then handoffs, then decisions, then needs, then findings"
- 01KM6CF41DRF6ZNMBZRBEQXB9R: "Enrich handoff data in AssembledContext to include individual results for detailed checklists"
- 01KM6CFBQ7WWV6FAGY73N5E9D3: "Filter redundant findings that substantially overlap with decision summaries in formatForLLM"
- 01KM6FNY5GTKCW02RFFG26W9RR: "Empty-state short-circuit in formatForLLM returns terse one-liner when no content exists"
- 01KM852D143D6GKWFPNGY01W30: "Add FILES TO CHECK BEFORE WRITING section to formatForLLM output"
- 01KM85N01B2T9DA4GWVP5JE9DY: "Assumption validation in assembler: check findings/warnings/decisions against decision assumptions"
- 01KM8XXFXJ0MVVVZYX6RD064MB: "Include constraints and rejected alternatives in assembled decision output for pattern propagation"
- 01KMT24SQ0EGJSH8Z9A6DDEXB4: "Filter out entry_type "decision" blackboard entries in assembler to prevent type confusion"
- 01KQ098D6RHXSBRHK40GFY70PB: "Default tool surface is 5 core tools (assemble, record, post, why, housekeeping); all other tools remain gated behind full_surface: true in config"
- 01KQV935XB6AMVC404F344S6GY: "Implemented strict equality check (=== 'true') for TWINING_DISABLED gate"
- 01KQV935Y7CWQWW12XRZ9CGH37: "Placed gate at line 21-23 in main() before any server initialization"
- 01KQWE98BS5015ZTYAS0QHXPYE: "Branch_gone signal is auto-neutralized when listLocalBranches() returns an empty set"
- 01KQWJMW9NKDHKDCZYDP968RPJ: "Don't distinguish merged-and-deleted from force-deleted branches"
- 01KQWJMWF88JGQRDRKFC6F6P8Y: "First-run is a no-op for archival"
- 01KWK9KV4JQP61XDP1GDFXP764: "Cross-process write-safety fixes from the multiwriter soak: exclusive-create (O_EXCL) for all file pre-creates, BEGIN IMMEDIATE around every sqlite read-modify-write, and lock retry budget (~24s) raised past the stale threshold (10s)"
- 01KWK9KV5FW2NC9RA2SJ4G0C57: "Export tree excludes agents and embeddings, and ingest never deletes without the corresponding kind directory present"
- 01KWMS1ETGRRNV4BW25Q1CQHJA: "Fixed the multiwriter-soak crash-tolerance flake by giving the victim writer an unfinishable op budget (VICTIM_OPS = OPS*100)"
- 01KWMYW8EYSG7H5MWVSS19AZYQ: "W3 1.x migrate leaves config.version at 1 and only flips storage.backend"
- 01KWN892XYHWDFBFBRVQP8E67A: "Reverse under export_records:false SKIPS ingest and exports from the database alone"
- 01KWN893175YCE3S3KR6F2F1KQ: "pre-reverse-backup/ is deliberately LAST-WINS (unlike config-edit's first-wins .pre-migrate.bak): it means 'what this run is about to overwrite', which is what makes a mistaken second reverse recoverable."
- 01KWNBQZBKKX7W1E2403PN5CZW: "Incompatible CLI flag combos are rejected at parse time (exit 2) rather than reinterpreted"
- 01KWQFW68JE8WBKAP1STHNJKF3: "Pending drain uses per-drain unique swap files with claim-by-rename recovery"
- 01KWT95C6HJ382RN2X04CM27AV: "migrate --reverse now restores config version to 1 (forward finalize stamps 2)"
- 01KWT95C9X8RE8M9Z77N72Q475: "Publish workflow gained a tag-vs-package.json version guard and prerelease GH-release marking alongside the dist-tag routing; checkout/setup-node bumped to v5"
- 01KWX1P1N11M4M6936XN94J20G: "Chose rule order: user keys summing to 1.0 ±0.01 treated as a complete set (missing keys zeroed) before any merge; otherwise merge over defaults and rescale proportionally to sum 1.0; full-default fallback reserved for genuinely invalid input (negative, non-numeric, all-zero, or priority_weights not a mapping)"
- 01KWX2BS60ABCXJBJXCTHWYM2R: "Removed the override() decision-type blackboard post along with decide()'s cross-post — both write entry_type "decision" mirrors that assemble filters out"
- 01KWX2BSA92FGQ6S5B0P2912RR: "twining_query/twining_recent merge decisions as a sibling `decisions` array (items marked type:"decision") rather than interleaving into results/entries"
- 01KWX2BSJAHZMRTEXS25N30ENB: "Kept the _internal blackboard post flag and the assemble/auto-archive entry_type "decision" exclusions as legacy-data defenses"
- 01KWX2CCWHH3QVCASADJ8N0TRZ: "Back-link rides the existing updateStatus(id, status, extra) path — no IDecisionStore interface change, no sqlite schema column"
- 01KWX2CD0DTRMWETSZEQGTVVG8: "Moved the supersede status flip in DecisionEngine.decide from before create to after create, writing status and superseded_by in one updateStatus call; conflict scan now excludes the supersede target"
- 01KWX2CD4YXB4HT5WBFKD0J4RT: "Housekeeping backfill preserves the target's current status — it writes only the missing superseded_by pointer, never flips active/archived/overridden to superseded"
- 01KWX2CD96VAG2X662E2B4MDVC: "Backfill pass runs by default (no opt-in flag), preview-reports / execute-applies like dedup; dangling supersedes targets are counted and skipped; newest supersessor wins when several point at one target"
- 01KWX2CDDJ2WKGD12X966SE96M: "why() emits superseded_by only when set (spread-conditional) rather than always-present nullable"
- 01KWX4BGN8MA7ECV7YZDX5XKKS: "Junk signature requires all six archiver-stamped fields: entry_type finding, summary /^Archive: \d+ entries archived$/, tags including "archive", scope "project", agent_id "main", detail /^Archive summary: \d+ entries archived\./"
- 01KWX4BGSKRFAM6JN6PSPC1A8A: "compact_archives is an opt-in housekeeping flag (like staleness_review/merge_sweep), not part of the default pass"
- 01KWX4BGXTT7XPTDGEQTPB23EA: "Compactor is a standalone module (src/engine/archive-compactor.ts) with ~15-line wiring into HousekeepingEngine.run — chose modularity over inlining because teammate supersede-31 is concurrently adding another housekeeping pass and merge conflicts must stay trivial"
- 01KWX4BH1Z9FXNDM6SMTZQVEFD: "Audit-trail finding is posted from the tool layer (housekeeping-tools.ts) with _skipAutoArchive, mirroring twining_archive_stale, rather than from the engine"
- 01KWX4BH64VBAQ4YPQJ9V989J8: "Execute mode streams survivors to a lazily-created same-directory temp file then renames atomically; files with zero junk are never rewritten; files that were already empty are not deleted"
- 01KWX4BHAEKWMMSF0HVETK03TG: "Compaction scans every *.jsonl under .twining/archive/ regardless of filename"
- 01KX3HED595XAZC4AT4F1VP8FM: "Recommended scale-native redesign of timeline/graph/lists (canvas density timeline, aggregated meta-graph + ego-network explorer capped ~200 nodes, server-windowed virtual lists, new Health panel, scope as first-class drill-down) over (a) conservative retrofit of vis-timeline/cytoscape which both lack aggregation modes and would stay mediocre, and (b) full framework rewrite which touches all 7 tabs to fix 3 and adds a build toolchain to a zero-config npm package. Not yet user-approved"
- 01KX3HRWR3J2ETM9A6X2S9NDEB: "Chose to keep vanilla JS split into native ES modules over adding a build step"
- 01KX3HRWV1666F03M5X0N7NTXA: "Chose to delete vis-timeline but retain cytoscape"
- 01KX3HRWZ3GC6R2VP672AP8E65: "Added .playwright-mcp/ to .gitignore"
- 01KX3SE6BRPB8YZVT9JCT00CMR: "Chose transitional coexistence of legacy app.js and new ES modules (main.js mounts new views per tab, window.__twiningStore bridge, legacy renderers deleted task-by-task) over a big-bang module conversion of the 3454-line app.js"
- 01KX49RDJF27SKMRYFF6FW8S38: "Chose a feature branch (dashboard-scale-redesign) over committing the redesign directly to main"
- 01KX49RDNJAEM58R6CQXVV9RMR: "Chose controller-commits with working-tree review packages over subagent commits"
- 01KX4E5JGRSACAGCGF0EJ0N0MV: "Fixed a discovered edge in virtualization during browser verification: filtering while scrolled deep left scrollTop beyond the shrunken content, rendering an empty window"
- 01KX4E5JJ0GW410CBBHE3GC8N3: "Kept renderBlackboardDetail in app.js (not yet moved) because navigateToId cross-links still render from legacy state"
- 01KX4EV8P9WYA0A98XB9HDZNQY: "Kept the existing toolbar/legend/chips DOM ids (timeline-zoom-in/out/fit/today, timeline-legend, timeline-domain-filters) so the HTML shell and its styling carried over unchanged"
- 01KX4EV8REJS5WBPH7RQRMFX81: "Lozenge lane layout uses first-fit lane assignment with label-width-aware collision (measureText) rather than vis-timeline-style stacking"
- 01KX4FNM939P13DK0XV14J9ME7: "Scope changes propagate two ways during the transition: setFilter({scope}) on module views and state.globalScope+refreshData() for legacy applyGlobalScope consumers (Search, Agents)"
- 01KX4NW8RTG00PP7WZAXB1XN3N: "Kept paginate/renderPagination/sortData/applyGlobalScope in app.js"
- 01KX4Q60YYS02NQHVQJ7N1BJWS: "Took R1-R3 + race guard immediately instead of deferring"
- 01KY11ZFRT8FHGGQ94K0WZDECZ: "Chose to commit directly to main rather than a PR branch"
- 01KY15ZAKB1S8NK01V10E5VHWW: "Chose to make the auto-archive threshold count exclude unresolved needs/warnings exactly (building the resolvedIds set per post) rather than excluding all needs/warnings approximately"
